fields.System.Title: INV-801 — Nightly ledger-vs-balance check
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a nightly job proving that the ledger still explains every
balance, so that a code path writing a balance without a movement is caught the next day
rather than the next year.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the job runs, then it sums movements per product, location, and batch and
  • compares the result to the balance.
  • - Given every balance agrees, then the job records a clean result.
  • - Given any disagreement, then it is recorded with product, location, expected, actual,
  • and difference.
  • - Given a disagreement, then the job does not correct it.
  • - Given the job, then it also checks that reservation rows sum to qty_reserved.
  • - Given production-sized data, then the job completes within its window.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement, reservation |
| Risks | Balance written without a movement ([doc 09 §2.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); auto-correcting hides the cause ([doc 08 §9](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · invariant · performance |
